title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1997 As seen above, a large number of prison inmates are undergoing/engaged in various vocational programmes. Rajasthan reported highest number of jail inmates involved in various training programme. This was followed by Uttar Pradesh (7263), Madhya Pradesh (1919), Maharashtra (1807), Karnataka (1685) and Andhra Pradesh (1375).
